claim_candidate_samples.artifact: manus-04/FORGE WORLD_ Human-Capability Layer for Industrial Execution.md
claim_candidate_samples.subject: industrial human capability
claim_candidate_samples.text: The missing layer is a structured capability system of qualified people, experienced teams, supervision, certifications, equipment familiarity, tacit knowledge, training capacity, institutional memory, and organizational routines.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: This is an architectural synthesis, not a measured workforce stock or production rate.
unknowns: Qualified people and experienced team counts by process, equipment, product, location, and shift.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Collect site-level authorization, shift, supervision, quality, maintenance, trainer, and transfer records before using the system as capacity.

claim_candidate_samples.artifact: manus-04/FORGE WORLD_ Human-Capability Layer for Industrial Execution.md
claim_candidate_samples.subject: industrial worker capability
claim_candidate_samples.text: A machinist, NDT technician, controls engineer, or cleanroom technician is not a generic interchangeable unit; the relation must include process, equipment, product, conditions, quality, rate, and evidence.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: The relation grammar is a model requirement; public sources do not provide a complete named-person or named-site inventory.
unknowns: Current authorization and recency by person, team, equipment configuration, material, and product.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Require a scoped capability record with local authorization, demonstrated quality/rate, supervision, and evidence date.

claim_candidate_samples.artifact: manus-04/FORGE WORLD_ Human-Capability Layer for Industrial Execution.md
claim_candidate_samples.subject: formal qualification
claim_candidate_samples.text: A certificate or completed course can establish a formal threshold, but it does not automatically establish independent production competence, unusual-failure mastery, or qualified annual throughput.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: Credential requirements are measured or reported by issuers; the distinction between credential and production capability is a model guard.
unknowns: Post-certification autonomous performance, defect escape rate, deviation recovery, and throughput.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Link each credential to method, scope, issue/expiry, local authorization, demonstrated jobs, and customer or regulatory acceptance.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: Germany dual VET
claim_candidate_samples.text: BIBB describes company and vocational-school venues, apprentices as employees, more than 300 recognized training occupations, typical two-to-three-and-a-half-year duration, and chamber examinations.

numbers.raw: two to three and a half years

claim_candidate_samples.caveat: Pathway duration and structure do not prove mastery of every employer's equipment, product, or failure mode.
unknowns: Completion, retention, independent qualification, and process-specific output by occupation and employer.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Obtain occupation-level completion, dropout, equipment exposure, trainer capacity, and employer outcome records.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: Singapore ITE advanced-manufacturing WSDip
claim_candidate_samples.text: ITE lists a 30-month work-study diploma with classroom blocks and workplace OJT tied to CAD/CAM, CNC, additive manufacturing, automation, quality, lean, and production management.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: The page establishes pathway design and named employer links, not graduate placement, retention, or autonomous production competence.
unknowns: Machine hours per trainee, completion, retention, line authorization, and first-pass quality.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Request cohort outcomes by employer, equipment family, task qualification, line qualification, and post-graduation retention.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: NIST advanced-manufacturing occupation framework
claim_candidate_samples.text: NIST identifies 132 entry-level occupations, 235 knowledge/skill/ability items, 13 competencies, and 68 sub-competencies.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: A taxonomy of required KSAs is not a measurement of worker supply, qualification, or facility capacity.
unknowns: Crosswalk completeness, local authorization, active practice, and supply by industrial process and geography.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Crosswalk framework terms to process/equipment-specific authorization and observed work outcomes without inferring supply.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: United States semiconductor workforce
claim_candidate_samples.text: SIA projects employment from approximately 345,000 to 460,000 by 2030 and estimates roughly 67,000 new jobs could go unfilled at current degree-completion rates.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: This is a modelled labor-market projection, not a direct measurement of fab-ready technicians, qualified teams, or production capacity.
unknowns: Qualified stock by tool family, facility, shift, authorization, recency, and independent productivity.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Replace projected job counts with facility-level staffing matrices, authorization records, yield outcomes, and retention.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: ASNT 9712 Level II NDT credential
claim_candidate_samples.text: ASNT lists MT and PT at 5 training days and 60 experience days, RT at 15 and 180, and UT at 18 and 180.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: Requirements are method-specific and do not prove every defect class, product scope, local authorization, or release throughput.
unknowns: Detection performance and independent competence under representative production defects.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Capture method, sector, product scope, issue/expiry, employer authorization, proficiency tests, and current practice.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: AWS Certified Welding Inspector
claim_candidate_samples.text: AWS examples include a bachelor's route with at least one year of welding experience, an associate route with at least two years, and a high-school route with at least five years.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: Eligibility and examination do not prove independent judgment for every code, material, geometry, plant, or abnormal condition.
unknowns: Plant-specific authorization, recency, defect detection, release authority, and production impact.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Link credential evidence to code, product, material, employer authorization, audit, and observed inspection outcomes.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: India NAPS-2 apprenticeship scheme
claim_candidate_samples.text: MSDE describes designated-trade durations of one year for ITI pass-outs and two years for freshers or non-ITI pass-outs; optional trades are generally six, nine, or twelve months.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: Administrative scheme duration and stipend rules do not establish high-precision, safety-critical, or autonomous competence.
unknowns: Completion, retention, task and line qualification, trainer ratio, first-pass yield, and post-apprenticeship quality outcomes.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Obtain cohort-level completion, retention, assessment, authorization, quality, safety, and employer conversion data by trade and cluster.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: TSMC Arizona technician apprenticeship
claim_candidate_samples.text: The official page describes application, skills assessment, interview, high-school or GED baseline, wages, benefits, college credit, and a journeyman-card feature; exact duration and autonomous fab qualification are not stated.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: Program existence is evidence of a capability-building mechanism, not evidence of completed qualification, retention, or throughput.
unknowns: Program duration, cohort size, completion, equipment scope, time to line qualification, and independent fab authorization.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Request program outcomes and link them to named equipment families, supervised hours, authorization gates, retention, and quality records.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: India Semiconductor Mission
claim_candidate_samples.text: The official site describes a semiconductor and display ecosystem mission, facilities, schemes, press releases, and a roadmap, but does not quantify qualified technician stock, retention, yield competence, or autonomous fab-running capability.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: Announcements, investment, and mission scope are not measured qualified staffing or operating capacity.
unknowns: Advanced-equipment technicians, cleanroom supervisors, yield engineers, facilities specialists, trainers, retention, and independent production competence.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Collect site-specific staffing matrices, OEM training records, authorization scopes, yield history, and local-versus-expatriate dependency.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: tacit knowledge in manufacturing inspection
claim_candidate_samples.text: Two UK aerospace visual-inspection case studies report that tacit skills matter where standards are underspecified or subjective and that systematic task analysis can elicit this knowledge.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: The study is limited to visual-inspection cases; it does not support a universal percentage of tacit expertise or universal codifiability.
unknowns: Generalization to machining, grinding, welding, foundry, semiconductor yield, rotating equipment, and other sectors.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Replicate task analysis across high-consequence processes and measure trainee outcomes, deviation-time reduction, and defect escapes.

claim_candidate_samples.artifact: manus-04/FORGE WORLD_ Human-Capability Layer for Industrial Execution.md
claim_candidate_samples.subject: institutional know-how
claim_candidate_samples.text: A nuclear QA system, semiconductor fab, turbine overhaul shop, or precision machine-tool plant requires cross-functional coordination; a single master technician cannot replace an experienced team.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: Team-level requirement is an architectural hypothesis until site-level response and recovery records measure it.
unknowns: Minimum role mix, supervision ratio, escalation response, succession depth, and replaceability by process.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Capture shift composition, response times, failure-mode libraries, mentor links, trainer outcomes, retention, and succession plans.

claim_candidate_samples.artifact: manus-04/FORGE WORLD_ Human-Capability Layer for Industrial Execution.md
claim_candidate_samples.subject: time_to_competence
claim_candidate_samples.text: TTC should be represented as a distribution with entry readiness, task qualification, line independence, deviation competence, transfer competence, and trainer competence stages.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: No universal time-to-competence law is established; evidence resolution must remain process- and site-specific.
unknowns: Distribution parameters, covariates, supervision effect, machine exposure, process complexity, and quality-regime effect.
conflicts: Different workstreams report short courses, multi-year apprenticeships, and long mastery periods with incompatible denominators.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Collect entry-to-stage timestamps, supervised hours, completed jobs, first-pass yield, defect escapes, deviations, repair times, assessments, and recency.

claim_candidate_samples.artifact: manus-04/FORGE WORLD_ Human-Capability Layer for Industrial Execution.md
claim_candidate_samples.subject: automation_and_skill
claim_candidate_samples.text: Automation can remove repetitive manual tasks while increasing setup, integration, monitoring, data interpretation, exception handling, maintenance, and cybersecurity requirements.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: OECD findings are based on studied cases; they do not establish a universal occupation-level outcome.
unknowns: Net displacement, work intensity, training delta, and exception-recovery burden by automation technology and process.
conflicts: Transformation and displacement may coexist; broad statements about every industrial occupation are not adjudicated.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Measure before/after task mix, authorized roles, failure modes, training hours, quality, safety, and staffing by automated line.

claim_candidate_samples.artifact: manus-04/FORGE WORLD_ Human-Capability Layer for Industrial Execution.md
claim_candidate_samples.subject: tacit_knowledge_risk
claim_candidate_samples.text: Precision grinding depends on coupled thermal drift, wheel condition, vibration, coolant behavior, and part response; capture strategies include signatures, setup records, expert debriefs, and trend analysis.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: The cited source is about hand scraping and human-AI collaboration; the extension to precision grinding is a model hypothesis, not a measured universal law.
unknowns: Which rare combinations remain uncodified and how knowledge capture changes yield, diagnosis time, and transfer.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Obtain machine/process histories, expert observation, controlled trials, and trainee outcome evidence for each grinder and part family.

claim_candidate_samples.artifact: manus-04/FORGE WORLD_ Human-Capability Layer for Industrial Execution.md
claim_candidate_samples.subject: facility_and_workforce_presence
claim_candidate_samples.text: An announced semiconductor fab does not imply qualified annual throughput; it requires a cleanroom equipment-maintenance team and other site-specific human capability.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: The claim is a guard against capacity laundering; it is not evidence that a named facility cannot operate.
unknowns: Facility status, staffing, authorization, equipment uptime, yield, product qualification, and sustainable output.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Require commissioning, staffing, training, equipment, qualification, yield, and time-windowed good-output evidence before capacity promotion.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: DOE Battery Workforce Initiative
claim_candidate_samples.text: DOE describes facility site visits, subject-matter interviews, job-task analysis, and employer-based testing and validation for battery operator and repair-technician standards.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: Training-standard validation is not proof that a graduate can transfer across chemistries, formats, equipment vendors, or plants.
unknowns: Credential completion, line authorization, independent productivity, cross-vendor transfer, retention, and quality outcomes.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Attach employer test results, equipment scope, chemistry and format, authorization state, and post-training production outcomes.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: industrial_tacit_expertise
claim_candidate_samples.text: The structured workstream memo states that tacit knowledge is estimated to comprise 90% of industrial expertise.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: The main memo explicitly rejects this as an established fact; the peer-reviewed evidence supports task-specific tacit knowledge, not a universal percentage.
unknowns: Operational definition, denominator, task scope, sector coverage, and reproducible measurement.
conflicts: Contradicted in scope by main memo L269-L275 and browser finding L70-L73.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Keep UNKNOWN/CONFLICTED; replace with process-specific elicitation and outcome measurements.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: India_apprenticeship_and_industrial_skill_pipeline
claim_candidate_samples.text: The structured workstream reports NAPS applications falling from 4.28 million in 2022 to about 400,000 in 2025 and cites conflicting EV skill-transfer and semiconductor talent-gap figures.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: The denominators, definitions, source quality, and scopes differ; the numbers must not be combined into a national qualified-capability stock.
unknowns: Official application denominator, completion and retention, active authorization, role definition, and sector scope.
conflicts: NAPS applications, semiconductor professional gap, EV skill share, and direct-transfer estimates are not commensurate variables.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Rebuild each series from dated official registers and employer records with explicit denominator, occupation, geography, and outcome.

claim_candidate_samples.subject: India NSDC NOS URL
claim_candidate_samples.text: The current NSDC URL returned an explicit Page not found page, so the prior claim cannot be treated as directly verified from this URL.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: A missing page is not evidence that the underlying standard or institution does not exist.
unknowns: Current official NOS/QP source, archival version, issue date, and scope.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Locate a current official or archived source and preserve retrieval date and version before using NOS/QP records.

claim_candidate_samples.artifact: manus-04/FORGE WORLD_ Human-Capability Layer for Industrial Execution.md
claim_candidate_samples.subject: named_facility_workforce_and_throughput
claim_candidate_samples.text: The package does not establish qualified throughput of any named facility or the current number of fully autonomous specialized workers; those require employer records, qualification logs, production-quality data, supervision ratios, and process-specific observation.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: This is an absence-of-public-evidence statement, not a claim that the capability does not exist.
unknowns: Qualified workforce stock, team structure, supervision, yield, downtime, authorized process scope, and available capacity.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Request time-stamped staffing, authorization, process, quality, yield, maintenance, and production records at the same resolution as the objective.

claim_candidate_samples.artifact: manus-04/FORGE WORLD_ Human-Capability Layer for Industrial Execution.md
claim_candidate_samples.subject: FORGE workforce model
claim_candidate_samples.text: The immediate priority is a capability ledger linking required skill, equipment, quality regime, credential, training route, actual people, team composition, evidence freshness, and bottleneck status.
claim_candidate_samples.caveat: This is a proposed representation, not an already populated canonical registry.
unknowns: Required staffing and authorization vectors for each target process, facility, shift, product, and ramp stage.
claim_candidate_samples.escalation: Pilot one high-consequence process with employer records and validate the ledger against commissioning, yield-ramp, qualification, and sustained-rate outcomes.
